why: 「binding long-term contracts」で program continuity と述べ拘束契約を名指し。ただし業界一般の記述。
「our ability to market them could be limited by the need for regulatory clearance」＝当社が受ける承認で向きが逆。
「cannot easily transfer designs to another foundry」＝顧客の固着を断定。再認定・再試験の語は無い。
「We work closely with major foundries」のみ＝願望形で、乗り換えの費用に一切触れない。
「Our future success may also depend on assisting our customers」＝依存・願望形で機構の名指しが無い。
「Our success ... depends」＋「competitors that already have a large installed base」＝設置基盤は競合側。
「Diversity and longevity」「breadth of our portfolio」＝自社の強みの自慢のみ。乗り換え費用に触れない。
「barriers to entry」「competition in this segment is limited」＝新規参入障壁で顧客の乗り換え費用ではない。
「long duration and no redemption clause」＝解約条項なしの拘束を「over 50% of our AUM」の実数つきで名指し。
「Suppliers must pass a rigorous qualification process」＝認定を受けるのは供給者側で向きが逆。
「customers choose alternate electric or gas suppliers」と乗り換えを前提に述べ、顧客側の費用の名指しが無い。
「New products ... may require separate approval as medical devices」＝当社の新製品が受ける承認の話。
「These products must conform to highly prescribed specifications developed by vehicle OEMs」＝適合の負担は当社。
「barriers to entry」「competition in this segment is limited」＝参入障壁の記述で顧客の再認定は無い。
「work closely with customers evaluating and qualifying」＝願望形かつ当社が認定を取りに行く側。
「qualified for the application by the OEM」「after years of design, testing and improvement」だが再認定の断定は無い。
「We establish, apply and enforce standards」「We grant licenses」＝新規参加者への入場要件にすぎない。
「Permanent Withdrawal Fees」を「We capitalize ... as customer acquisition costs」＝払うのは当社で向きが逆。

mech: 解約率・更新率の実数
why: 「approximately 99% of our 2013 revenue continued」「high switching costs」「embedded nature」を実数で断定。
「We believe that the barriers to entry ... are generally high」＝参入障壁の主観で乗り換え費用は無い。
「conversion of existing client assets」「a contractual minimum fee in place」＝顧客側の資産移行と最低料金を名指し。
「Once ... designed into a given OEM customer's product」「significant barriers to subsequent supplier changes」を断定。
「qualified for the application by the OEM, the U.S. Department of Defense, the FAA」だが再認定の断定が無い。
「instruments are placed at customer sites」「multi-year customer commitment to purchase instrument consumables」。
「a significant commitment of resources by prospective customers」＝導入費用は顧客側。ただし may entail の緩い断定。
「required to qualify a pump for use with their products」＝当社が認定してもらう側で、乗り換え時の記述が無い。
「we believe that significant brand loyalty ... continues」＝ブランドの自慢のみで乗り換え費用に触れない。
